name: Session Tree + No Worktree Mode
description: Chats with or without a worktree, and every open agent session in one tree by project, native chats included: what is working, what waits for you, what finished unread. No Worktree Mode blocks new worktrees in every project or only chosen ones. Right-click to mark read, close or remove.

settings.title: No Worktree Mode
settings.description: On: Orca creates no new worktrees anywhere (sidebar, composer, CLI, automations) and chats start in each project's main checkout. In either mode, "Ban or allow new worktrees in this project" makes an exception for the open project.
enumLabels: Off: worktrees allowed, ban single projects
